text:
Maya: Quick check  midyear recognition kiosk at HQ + remote pickup station next Wed. need volunteer coverage, petty cash, and cross-border e-gift rules.
Evan: I can do AM shift 911.30. Will we have a backup for cash reconciliation?
Priya: I'll do afternoon and handle offline entries. I'll bring a clipboard + laptop for batch upload.
Lena: Logistics: 100 printed recognition slips in the supply room, 60 pins, 40 tees (mixed sizes), and a small float bag with $150.
Carlos: Procurement note: for APAC recipients, prefer local retailer vouchers; digital USD cards sometimes fail on local banks.
finance-bot: Reminder: awards > $100 must be flagged for payroll and require manager + director approval. See policy: /policies/comp/awards.
Maya: Kiosk rules proposal: default award $50 e-gift OR physical pin/tee. Managers can nominate up to $250 with approval stickers.
Evan: Approval sticker idea: preprint 30 sheets with manager name + date fields. volunteers can attach sticker if approved.
Priya: Offline form will have fields: recipient name, manager, amount, country, approval sticker ID. finance-bot can ingest csv.
peopleops-bot: Event task: add recognition supplies to inventory by Tue EOD or they'll be marked missing.
Lena: Accessibility: we'll set a "Private Recognition" drawer and a low-sensory table. add option "no stage mention" on the slip.
Carlos: Post-event fulfillment for remote winners: team will email options (local voucher or international e-gift). lead time 3 days for local voucher bulk buys.
Evan: Can comms do a 1-page FAQ card for the kiosk: "How it works", "Taxes & reporting", "Delivery times"?
Maya: Yes please. Also need signage: "Recognition Kiosk" and "Quiet Table" (A2).
Priya: Volunteer rota suggestion:
- 9:0011:30 Evan + Maya
- 11:304:00 Maya + Lena
- 14:006:30 Priya + floater
Lena: I'll bring a small labeler and sealed envelopes for surprise awards.
Carlos: I'll post the approved vendor list for APAC by Tue noon.
finance-bot: Note: include country code in entries to trigger correct tax workflow.
Maya: Action items:
1) Lena: bring envelopes + labeler + inventory count (Mon)
2) Priya: prepare offline CSV template + upload instructions (Mon EOD)
3) Evan: confirm morning shift and bring petty cash lockbox (Tue AM)
4) Comms: FAQ card + signage (requested)
peopleops-bot: Checklist created: /docs/events/midyear/recognition-kiosk-checklist.pdf
Evan: One question  can managers pre-approve a batch of nominations before the event? that would speed things up.
Maya: Yes  we can accept pre-approvals. send CSV to people-ops and we'll prep labeled envelopes.
Priya: Also adding a short note on receipts: mobile photo of receipt is fine; volunteers should take a picture on upload.
Carlos: Don't forget to set timezone on e-gift delivery for APAC recipients so they don't receive at odd hours.
Lena: All set from my side. excited to run this. :tada:
Maya: Thanks everyone. I'll lock the roster tomorrow at 5pm and post the signup in #all-hands.
peopleops-bot: Volunteer roster will be locked 2026-05-12T17:00:00Z.
finance-bot: Closing note: any award labeling >$150 needs director signature on the physical approval form.
